quick.title: Quick
quick.description: garak's tier 1 probes (of most concern) with 10 prompts each: a first look. Too few prompts for garak's calibrated (relative) scores to be reliable.

standard.title: Standard
standard.description: garak's tier 1 probes (of most concern) with up to 30 prompts each: enough for garak's calibrated scores. The default for models added to the library.

thorough.title: Thorough
thorough.description: garak's tier 1 and tier 2 probes (adds toxicity, malware, misleading claims, data replay and attack generation) with up to 128 prompts each, 3 answers per prompt: hours to days on CPUs.
